overall_verdict: CL-01 and CL-05 are supported, CL-02 requires the revised term about as likely as not (33–66 %), CL-03 is implausible on its declared field range, and CL-04 has too few independent families for a supported claim.
limitations: All authoritative inputs are synthetic JSON summaries, not independently inspected NetCDF files; the units and field extrema are used exactly as declared, with no conversion.
The live Pangeo catalog and ensemble-statistics checks were unavailable because intake was not installed, so live models, means, percentiles and tool-count discrepancies cannot be reported.
The sign-agreement values and the supplied model-family map are treated as authoritative; no independent model-lineage or raw-simulation verification was performed.

Family-agreement fractions select the labels under the brief's scale and are not empirical event probabilities; AR6 probability ranges are reported alongside each likelihood term as calibrated language.
No field-native validation, regridding, bias correction or regional-statistics computation was performed beyond the supplied summaries.
